privacy_meta_description: How Dress Doctor collects, uses and protects your details. Written in plain, simple words.
privacy_hero_lead: How we collect, use and protect your details when you book a pickup, choose a plan or visit our website.
privacy_tldr_collect: We only collect what we need to pick up, clean and return your clothes.
privacy_tldr_sell: We never sell your details. Ever.
privacy_tldr_payment: Payments go through mobile money and card providers. We do not keep your card number.
privacy_tldr_delete: Ask us to delete your details at any time. We will do it within 30 days.
privacy_intro_p1: Dress Doctor Limited (“**Dress Doctor**”, “**we**” or “**us**”) runs a laundry and dry-cleaning service in Douala, Cameroon. We collect your clothes from your door and bring them back clean. This policy explains what details we collect, why we use them, who we share them with, and what choices you have.
privacy_intro_p2: It covers our website, our online booking, our WhatsApp and phone bookings, and everything you share with our riders, our customer care team and our laundry staff.
privacy_intro_promiseBody: We look after your details the way we look after your clothes: with care, only what we need, and never passed to people who should not have them.
privacy_collect_intro: We only collect what we need to run your laundry service. Here is what that means.
privacy_collect_nameText: so our rider greets the right person at your door.
privacy_collect_phoneText: to confirm your pickup, tell you when the rider is on the way, and call you if a garment needs attention.
privacy_collect_emailText: to send receipts or monthly statements, if you ask for them.
privacy_collect_languageText: so we can write to you in English, French or Pidgin.
privacy_collect_addressText: including any notes you give us, like “call when you arrive” or “leave it with the gatekeeper”.
privacy_collect_countText: what we collected and what we brought back.
privacy_collect_notesText: fabric worries, old stains, items that must not go in the dryer, and how you like them ironed.
privacy_collect_photosText: if a garment has a stain, a tear or old damage, our rider takes a photo before it leaves your home. This lets us compare when we bring it back. We delete these photos after 90 days.
privacy_collect_paymentBody: Mobile money (MTN MoMo and Orange Money) and card payments are handled by the payment provider. We only see the payment reference and the amount. We never see your PIN or your card number.
privacy_collect_messagesBody: We keep your WhatsApp messages, SMS and call notes about your orders. This way, any team member who helps you can see what was said. If we record a customer care call, we keep the recording for 60 days to train our team.
privacy_use_intro: We only use your details for a clear reason:
privacy_use_serviceText: Plan pickups, send riders, track your clothes, bring them back and send you the bill.
privacy_use_talkText: Confirm orders, tell you when the rider is close, send delivery photos and reply to your messages.
privacy_use_qualityText: Solve problems, look into damage reports and improve how we care for fabrics.
privacy_use_improveText: See which areas we serve well and where we need more riders. We only look at group figures, never at one person.
privacy_use_lawText: Keep receipts and accounts for as long as Cameroon law says we must.
privacy_use_never: We do not use your details to build adverts about you, to train AI tools, or to send offers you did not ask for.
privacy_share_intro: Very few people see your details. They are:
privacy_share_teamText: riders, laundry staff and customer care. They only see what they need for their work.
privacy_share_paymentText: MTN MoMo, Orange Money and our card provider. They get what they need to take your payment, and nothing more.
privacy_share_techText: they must protect your details to the same standard as this policy.
privacy_share_lawText: only when the law forces us to, with a valid official request.
privacy_share_neverBody: We never sell your details. We never share them with data sellers, advert companies or marketers.
privacy_cookies_intro: Our website uses a few small files (cookies) and similar storage to work well. There are two kinds.
privacy_cookies_neededLanguage: Your language and your chosen plan, so the page remembers them next time.
privacy_cookies_neededSignIn: A sign-in code, if you sign in.
privacy_cookies_countHeading: To count visits (you can say no)
privacy_cookies_countVisits: Simple page-visit counts, so we know which parts people use.
privacy_cookies_countDevice: General device details, like your browser and screen size, to help us design the pages.
privacy_cookies_outro: We do not use advert trackers, and we do not follow your device across other websites. You can clear cookies in your browser at any time. You will not lose your account.
privacy_messages_p1: When you book a pickup, we send you messages about it: booking confirmations, rider arrival times, delivery photos and receipts. These are part of the service. You cannot turn them off while you have an open order.
privacy_messages_p2: We may also send care tips and offers, but only if you asked for them. You can stop them at any time. Use the link in the message, or reply STOP on WhatsApp or SMS.
privacy_keep_title: How long we keep your details
privacy_keep_intro: We only keep your details for as long as we need them.
privacy_keep_ordersText: 4 years after your last order, for our accounts and in case you have a complaint.
privacy_keep_photosText: 90 days after the order is closed.
privacy_keep_callsText: 60 days, then they are deleted automatically.
privacy_keep_offersText: Until you unsubscribe. After that, we only keep a note that you said stop, so we do not add you again by mistake.
privacy_keep_taxText: 10 years, as Cameroon business law requires.
privacy_rights_intro: Cameroon Law No. 2010/012 of 21 December 2010 on cybersecurity and cybercrime, and our own promise to treat your details well, give you these rights:
privacy_rights_seeText: the details we hold about you.
privacy_rights_correctText: anything that is wrong or out of date.
privacy_rights_deleteText: your account and the details linked to it. We must keep some records for tax or legal reasons.
privacy_rights_copyText: of your order history, in a file you can keep.
privacy_rights_objectText: to some uses of your details, such as offers and tips.
privacy_rights_outro: To use any of these rights, email us or message us on WhatsApp. We reply within 5 working days and finish most requests within 30 days.
privacy_safe_title: How we keep your details safe
privacy_safe_intro: We take sensible steps to stop your details from being lost, seen by the wrong people or changed. These include:
privacy_safe_https: A secure connection (HTTPS) on every page that collects or shows your details.
privacy_safe_access: Access limits, so only staff who need your details can see them.
privacy_safe_lock: A locked area at our laundry for tagged clothes that are waiting for delivery.
privacy_safe_review: Regular checks on who else can see your details, and whether they still need to.
privacy_safe_outro: No system is 100% safe. If your details are ever put at risk, we will tell you and the authorities within 72 hours. We will explain what happened and what we are doing about it.
privacy_children_body: Our service is for adults aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect details from children. If you think a child has given us their details, please contact us and we will delete them.
privacy_changes_intro: We may change this policy when our service changes or when the law changes. If we make an important change, we will:
privacy_changes_date: Change the “Effective” date at the top of this page.
privacy_changes_notify: Send our active customers an SMS or email that explains what changed.
privacy_changes_archive: Keep the old versions, and send you one if you ask.
privacy_contact_intro: Do you have a question about this policy, a worry about your details, or a request? We want to hear from you.
privacy_help_body: The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp. When we are open, most messages get a reply within 5 minutes.
